reason: At $24.99 it works out to about 83 cents a day, and the money-back guarantee means I am not stuck if I hate it. A sachet in my bag might actually get taken, unlike the bottle on my counter that I forget. I would only do it at the launch price, not $29.99.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, one foil packet a day, 30 a month. And I would still want to know I am not overpaying per day compared to a regular bottle of magnesium.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was the full $29.99 with no coupon, I would pass and buy a bottle instead.
